final: WITH st AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.State), ''), '(none)') AS state, SUM(i.Total) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1) SELECT SUM(total) AS sum_state_totals, AVG(n) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM st
